title: HR Administrator
description:
Job Title: HR Administrator

Location: Sharston, Manchester M22 4 SN

Salary: £27,411.66 per annum

Job type: Full time, Permanent

About us:

Established in 2000, Express Solicitors is an award-winning, no win no fee law firm specialising exclusively in personal injury claims. Headquartered in Manchester, we support clients nationwide across all areas of personal injury, including employers' liability, serious injury, clinical negligence, occupiers' and public liability, road traffic accidents and industrial disease.

We are ranked 64th in The Lawyer UK Top 200, out of more than 10,000 law firms nationwide, and after achieving a 20% year-on-year growth, Express Solicitors are the largest personal injury claimant firm in the UK.

Our commitment to outstanding client care is reflected in our Trustpilot rating of 4.8 (Excellent), placing us among the highest-rated firms in the sector.

About The Role:

We are currently recruiting for a HR Administrator to provide administrative support to our HR Team. This is an exciting opportunity for a talented administrator to join our team and gain valuable HR specialist experience. The right candidate will have the chance to develop their HR career.

Responsibilities:
- Maintain accurate absence records by updating holiday, sickness, medical, and authorised leave information within the HR system.
- Verify that employees enter their data correctly on the HR platform.
- Send a daily absence summary email to all staff.
- Respond to routine staff enquiries in a timely and helpful manner.
- Support the HR team with various projects, such as absenteeism initiatives, company newsletters, HR system improvements, and updates to policies and procedures.
- Coordinate with new starters once an offer is made, including preparing and issuing employment contracts, requesting references, and organising their system setup.
- Deliver induction sessions for new starters.
- Complete checklists for new hires, internal promotions, and leavers to ensure smooth transitions. This includes collaborating with Department Heads and the IT team to share relevant information promptly.
- Ensure personnel files are kept accurate, up-to-date, and well organised.
- Provide general administrative support including filing, scanning, and taking minutes during employee meetings.
- Work with benefits providers, generate ad hoc reports, and liaise with Department Managers as needed.
- Carry out any additional ad hoc duties as required.

Person Specification:
- GCSE Maths and English at Grade 5 or above (or international equivalent).
- Strong administrative and organisational skills.
- Good numerical ability.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
- Flexible and able to prioritise tasks effectively in a dynamic environment.
- Resilient and capable of working under pressure.
- Willing and eager to learn.
- Excellent understanding of confidentiality, with the ability to handle sensitive information discreetly.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Confident and professional telephone manner.
- High level of accuracy and strong attention to detail.
- Demonstrated ability to coordinate and manage information effectively.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment.
- Previous HR administration experience and an understanding of UK employment law are desirable but not essential.
- A relevant HR qualification is an advantage.

Salary & Hours:
- Salary of £27,411.66 based on 39.5 hours
- Our standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:30pm Monday-Thursday and 8:30am to 5pm Friday.

Benefits:
- Hybrid Working - 3/2 hybrid working pattern after probation.
- 23 Days Holiday - Rising to 26 days, plus bank/public holidays.
- Extra Holidays - 3 holiday buy backs and an extra day for your birthday after service length requirement.
- Looking After Your Health - Private medical insurance available after 2 years' service, annual flu jab and Employee Assistance Programme.
- Looking After Your Well-being - 24/7 onsite Gym, Netball/Football team, 10km Manchester team and more.
- Work Life / Balance - Active social committee with generous departmental and firm-wide social budget.

Recruitment Process:

Interviews will be conducted by MS Teams and will include scenario-based questioning.

Our employees are our most important asset, we rate skill and ability above all else and our recruitment policy encourages applications from all.

Please click APPLY to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

Candidates with the relevant experience or job titles of; HR Assistant, Human Resources Assistant, Human Resources Executive, HR Executive, Human Resources Administrator, HR Advisor, Human Resources Advisor, HR Generalist, Human Resources Admin, HR Officer, HR Admin may also be considered for this role.

title: HR Administrator
company: Michael Page Business Support - Agency - Permanent
description:
As an HR Administrator in Manchester, you'll play a key role in keeping the Human Resources department running smoothly. From handling administrative tasks to supporting HR processes, you'll ensure everything stays organised and on track in the industrial and manufacturing industry.

Client Details

This role is within the industrial and manufacturing industry, based in Manchester.

Description
- Maintain and update employee records accurately and efficiently.
- Assist with recruitment processes, including coordinating interviews and managing correspondence.
- Support onboarding activities, such as preparing contracts and induction materials.
- Handle HR-related queries and provide administrative support to the team.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and employment regulations.
- Prepare reports and documentation as required by the HR department.
- Coordinate training sessions and maintain records of employee development.
- Assist in processing payroll and managing employee benefits.

Profile

A successful HR Administrator should have:
- Previous experience in an HR or administrative role.
- Strong organisational and multitasking skills.
- Attention to detail and a proactive approach to work.
- Knowledge of HR systems and Microsoft Office tools.
- Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
- An understanding of employment laws and HR best practices.

Job Offer
- An hourly rate of £14.00 to £17.00, dependent on the level of experience.
- Hybrid working arrangements for a better work-life balance.
- A temporary position within the Manchester area.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Learning & Development Coordinator

Salary: £15 per hour, depending on experience

Established in 2000, Express Solicitors is an award-winning, no win no fee law firm specialising exclusively in personal injury claims. title: Senior People Services Administrator
company: Great Places Housing Association - Agency - Permanent
description:
You will deliver an effective and efficient People Services administration function to the People team and all Great Places colleagues, ensuring the accurate delivery of People processes across the employee lifecycle. You will act as the senior point of contact within the People Service Centre, providing quality assurance, supporting continuous improvement activities and supervising and developing a team of three People Services Administrators through day-to-day leadership, coaching and regular one-to-one (Great Conversation) meetings.

What you'll be doing
- Lead, supervise and develop a team of three People Services Administrators, ensuring workloads are effectively managed and service standards are achieved.
- Be the senior point of contact for People queries from colleagues and managers, resolving complex enquiries in a timely manner.
- Manage colleague lifecycle administration, including recruitment, onboarding, contractual changes, benefits administration and leavers.
- Conduct regular one-to-one meetings (Great Conversations), providing coaching, feedback and development support.
- Support performance management activities, helping colleagues achieve individual and team objectives.
- Provide a high level of customer service, contributing to a positive experience for all colleagues who interact with the People Service Centre.
- Process complex or sensitive administration activities and act as an escalation point for the team.
- Collate and review monthly payroll information including new starters, leavers and contractual amendments. .
- Review HR documents, ensuring accuracy, compliance and adherence to policy.
- Review work completed by People Services Administrators, providing guidance and support to maintain high standards.
- Coordinate onboarding administration, including new starter documentation, reference requests, right to work checks and DBS applications.
- Maintain People systems and records, ensuring data integrity, GDPR compliance and accurate payroll reporting.
- Monitor team workloads, priorities and service levels to ensure deadlines and service standards are achieved.
- Manage administration relating to colleague benefits, including WPA, The Marketplace, the Great Places Lottery and annual leave schemes.
- Support the delivery of People projects, audits and service improvement activities.
- Monitor and administer HR systems including Cascade, The Marketplace and Expenses+.
- Work closely with the Recruitment Team to ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new colleagues.
- Process People Team invoices, including raising purchase orders through the Finance system.
- Produce management information, service reports and data to support decision making and service improvements.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes, systems and ways of working within the People Service Centre.
- Assist with induction, training and mentoring of new team members.

What we need from you
- Experience of working within a HR or People Services administration environment.
- Experience of supervising or coordinating the work of others.
- Experience of using HR systems and maintaining accurate employee records.
- Experience of Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- A commitment to understand the challenges and opportunities that exist in the communities in which we work. We particularly value lived experience in social housing
- A passion to advocate on behalf of people and communities
- A commitment to work in partnership with others for the benefit of Great Places
- A commitment to continuous learning and improvement
- Ability to work flexibly and when needed

What you'll need
- Qualified to minimum GCSE Grade C/4 or equivalent in English and Maths.
- CIPD Level 3 qualified or working towards (desirable).
- Ability to organise and prioritise workloads for both yourself and others.
- A passion for customer service and continuous improvement.
- Ability to maintain confidentiality at all times.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
- Professional and value led with integrity, inclusivity and respect for diversity.
- Ability to coach and support colleagues to achieve high performance.
- Understanding of employment legislation, data protection and HR best practice.

What we give you in return for your hard work and commitment
- Pension DC scheme (up to 10% contribution from both colleagues and Great Places)
- WPA Healthcare scheme starts at no contribution level with £1250 of savings available per year (option to increase & add family members)
- Ways of Working We offer some hybrid and flexible working
- Annual leave Start at 26 days annual leave, increasing up to 30 days within 5 years + Bank Holidays
- Reward & Recognition You Count Rewards are individual reward's for going 'above & beyond'
- Professional fees The business pays the cost of one professional role related membership fee for each colleague
- The Market Place high street, restaurant & supermarket discounts, gym memberships, cycle to work, smart tech loans and much more
- Wage Stream You can access savings opportunities and early access to wages
- Health and Wellbeing Initiatives Our colleagues enjoy wellbeing campaigns throughout the year, with activities designed around our four pillars of wellbeing, these include career wellbeing, mental wellbeing, physical wellbeing and financial wellbeing

At Great Places we believe the wellbeing of our colleagues is vital to enable them to deliver to great services, all your benefits can be used inside and outside of work.
